scenes.script_line: Last point, and a test of character. When you see something wrong that is not “your job” — a fallen branch on the boardwalk, a dirty window, litter by the pool — there are two kinds of people. The one who thinks “someone should sort that out”, and the one who sorts it or reports it within the hour.
